summary: This joint resolution nullifies the CFPB rule (90 Fed. Reg. 20084) that withdrew its prior requirements on medical debt collection and consumer reporting under the No Surprises Act.

scores.thoughts: The bill is a CRA disapproval resolution targeting a CFPB regulatory action on medical debt reporting. It has no provisions that authorize, appropriate, or alter any government spending levels.
No tax provisions, rate changes, or revenue measures appear in the text.

The underlying bulletin concerns medical debt collection and credit reporting under the No Surprises Act, but the resolution itself only nullifies a withdrawal rule and does not address coverage models, insurance markets, or public vs. private healthcare systems.
